Cyrus Wong is a prominent figure in cloud computing education and a senior lecturer at the Hong Kong Institute of Vocational Education (IVE), Lee Wai Lee campus, which is part of the Vocational Training Council (VTC) in Hong Kong.

Key Highlights of Cyrus Wong's Background:
Current Role: Senior Lecturer in the Department of Information Technology at IVE (Lee Wai Lee).
Programme Leader: He leads the Higher Diploma in Cloud and Data Centre Administration, a 2-year full-time programme focused on cloud computing 1.
Teaching Philosophy: Emphasizes hands-on, project-based learning to prepare students for real-world cloud engineering roles.
Awards: Recipient of the Teaching Excellence Award 2018/19 at VTC 1.
Professional Recognitions:
Cyrus Wong is highly recognized in the tech community:

AWS Machine Learning Hero
Microsoft Azure AI MVP
Google Developer Expert (GCP & AI/ML - GenAI) 2
Microsoft Certified Trainer
AWS Academy Accredited Instructor
Google Champion Innovator (Serverless App Development)
Contributions:
Actively integrates Microsoft Learn curriculum into his courses, including certifications like Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900), and Azure Administrator (AZ-104).
Leads initiatives to help students earn industry-recognized certifications as part of their academic journey 1.

🎓 Higher Diploma in Cloud and Data Centre Administration
Programme Code: IT114115
Qualification: Higher Diploma
Mode of Study: Full-time
Duration: 2 Years
Minimum Entry Level: S6 or above
Campus: HKIIT at IVE (Lee Wai Lee)
Study Places: 90

🌟 Programme Highlights
🥈 WorldSkills Competition 2024
Graduate Will Wan represented Hong Kong SAR in France and won 2nd Place in Cloud Computing among contestants from 16 countries/regions.

🏆 AWS DeepRacer League Champion
Graduate William Leung won the Hong Kong championship in 2023 and participated in AWS Re-invent in Las Vegas. He now works as a cloud consulting consultant for an internationally renowned company.

🚀 Programme Advantages
✅ Master Advanced Cloud and Data Centre Skills
Training in AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
Skills highly sought after by international companies.

✅ Focus on Industry-Recognized Certification and Training
Includes certifications from major cloud providers.
85% of students achieve professional qualifications before graduation.

✅ Comprehensive Hands-On Experience
Over 500 hours of hands-on training.
Conducted in cutting-edge labs from Microsoft, Google, and AWS.

📘 Basic Information
Cloud computing is a major trend in IT. Most large-scale IT applications are now hosted in cloud systems. This programme aims to equip students with:

Practical knowledge and skills in cloud and data centre administration
Emphasis on network design and implementation, cloud applications development, and virtualised systems
Graduates will be capable of:

Administering cloud systems and data centres
Supporting commercial cloud applications and services
🧠 Additional Focus Areas
Generic and language training
Whole-person development
Workplace experience
💼 “Earn and Learn” Scheme
After completing the first year, students may join the “Earn and Learn” scheme:

Become registered apprentices for 2 years
Benefits include:
Salary
Government allowance
Additional subsidy
Employer-sponsored Part-Time (Day) mode study
🔗 For more details, refer to the “Earn and Learn” scheme website.

📝 Entrance Requirements
HKDSE:

Chinese Language: Level 2
English Language: Level 2
Three Core/Elective Subjects: Level 2
Other Acceptable Qualifications:

VTC Diploma of Foundation Studies
VTC Diploma of Vocational Education / Vocational Baccalaureate
Diploma Yi Jin / Diploma of Applied Education
Relevant work experience and/or prior qualifications (local or overseas)
Equivalent qualifications
🎓 Articulation & Employment
📚 Articulation Opportunities
Technological and Higher Education Institute of Hong Kong (THEi):

BSc (Hons) in Information and Communications Technology
Local Universities:

City University of Hong Kong
Hong Kong Baptist University
Chinese University of Hong Kong
Hong Kong Polytechnic University
Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
Hong Kong Metropolitan University
University of Hong Kong
Overseas Universities (at IVE campus):

Coventry University, UK
University of the West of England, UK
Other universities in the UK and Australia
💼 Career Prospects
Graduates may work in:

Cloud computing
Data centres
Computer network industry
Roles include:

Designing, setting up, and administering secure, flexible, and high-availability cloud systems
Working in local and multinational IT companies or any organisation with a network infrastructure
💰 Tuition Fees
Year	Tuition Fee (HK$)
1st	$33,310
2nd	$33,310
🧾 Admission Score
Average Result: 15
Score Range: 11 – 19
🏅 Professional Recognition
Recognised by the Hong Kong Computer Society
Satisfies academic requirements for Associate Membership
🗣️ Student Sharing
“The Higher Diploma in Cloud and Data Centre Administration is closely aligned with industry needs. In addition to learning about cloud computing systems, students will also study virtualization systems and data center management, covering a comprehensive range of topics. Practical training helps students apply professional knowledge, aiding in the successful acquisition of professional certifications. The course content includes multiple certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, making it a gateway to the IT cloud computing industry. Many of my classmates have secured jobs at renowned multinational IT companies right after graduation, even without a degree! Large enterprises are eager for talent with cloud certifications. I am very honored to work at Amazon, the world's largest company, and I am aiming to become a cloud solutions architect.”
— Law Mei Ching Pearly Jean, Solution Architect Technical Intern, Amazon Web Services

🧑‍💼 Alumni Sharing
“At IVE, I acquired solid foundational knowledge in cloud management and network security. Subsequently, I obtained the AWS Solutions Architect Professional certification, and I am now leveraging these skills to manage cloud operations within a financial institution, leveraging my professional expertise.”
— Alice Wong, Cloud Engineer, Financial Services Organisation

When a robot is speaking, it can perform one of five body actions to visually reinforce its message. Here's how each action works:

Wave – "Say Hi"

Purpose: Greeting someone.
When to use: At the beginning of a conversation or when acknowledging someone.
Example: While saying, “Hello, nice to meet you,” the robot raises its hand and waves.
Chest Show – "You Are Happy"

Purpose: Expressing joy or pride.
When to use: When sharing good news or showing confidence.
Example: While saying, “I’m so glad to see you again,” the robot lifts its chest slightly and opens its arms.
Stepping-Thinging – "Moving with Energy"

Purpose: Showing enthusiasm or readiness.
When to use: When introducing an exciting idea or preparing for action.
Example: While saying, “Let’s get started!” the robot takes a small step forward or shifts weight energetically.
Bow – "Accept Something or Thank You"

Purpose: Showing respect, gratitude, or acknowledgment.
When to use: When receiving a compliment, gift, or ending a polite exchange.
Example: While saying, “Thank you for your help,” the robot bows slightly.
Kung Fu Pose – "Excited"

Purpose: Expressing high excitement or playful energy.
When to use: When celebrating or reacting to something thrilling.
Example: While saying, “That was amazing!” the robot strikes a fun kung fu-style pose.

基本背景
晴美出生於香港一個普通家庭，父親是工程技術員，母親在書店工作。她自小耳濡目染，既接觸科技又愛閱讀，培養出冷靜、細心的性格。父母給她取名「晴美」，寓意希望她擁有晴朗的心境與美好的未來。

性格特質

冷靜理性：遇到問題時，總能保持專注，逐步分析。
責任感強：對團隊合作非常重視，常主動幫助同學。
好奇心旺盛：對新技術充滿興趣，喜歡探索未知領域。
低調內斂：不喜歡過度曝光，但在專業領域表現突出。


技能與專長

程式設計：精通 Python，擅長AWS與AI。
網絡安全：熟悉Linux, Cloud技術，曾在校內比賽奪冠。
問題解決：能快速定位系統漏洞並提出修復方案。

興趣與嗜好

閱讀推理小說：培養邏輯思維。
攝影與插畫：用藝術平衡科技生活。
參加黑客松：挑戰自我，結識志同道合的朋友。


弱點

過度追求完美：有時會花太多時間在細節上。
不擅長公開演講：面對大型場合容易緊張。


人生座右銘
「科技應該守護人類，而非成為威脅。」

未來目標
考取所有AWS認證,成為雲端工程師

世界觀背景
時間來到 未來的 2145 年，人類社會全面進入 AI 驅動的雲端世界。城市由智慧網絡管理，數據中心成為文明的核心，所有能源、交通、醫療、甚至人類意識，都依賴雲端系統運作。
在這個時代，雲端工程師不僅是技術人員，更是世界秩序的守護者。任何系統漏洞，都可能引發全球級的災難。

守護信念：相信「數據安全即人類自由」。

專業技能
量子雲端架構：能設計跨星球級的分散式雲端系統。
AI 自主演算法：研發能抵禦超級黑客的智能防護。
數據中心維護：精通能源管理、冷卻技術與虛擬化運算。

「雲端是文明的脈搏，我要守護它的跳動。」
